summary: The session provides a comprehensive negotiation cheat sheet for data and analytics leaders, outlining ten essential tips and techniques to enhance bargaining power with technology and AI vendors. Each tip emphasizes the importance of asking the right questions and leveraging competitive environments to secure better deals. Attendees are encouraged to utilize these strategies effectively in their negotiations.

key_points: Overview of the negotiation cheat sheet
Importance of negotiation leverage
Use RFPs to create competition
Importance of operational feasibility in switching vendors
Insist on receiving all pricing options
Analyze vendor proposals critically
Ask vendors about their compensation structure
Build rapport to gather information
Leverage vendor financial results for negotiation
Keep track of fiscal year-end dates
Avoid contract end dates coinciding with fiscal year ends
Plan negotiations well in advance
Regularly review contracts for renegotiation opportunities
Calculate value of unused products
Use vendor websites for negotiation insights
Delegate research tasks to vendor management teams
Know the dealmaker and their influence
Involve C-level executives in negotiations
Allocate sufficient time for negotiations
Prepare for potential escalations

key_takeaways: Utilize RFPs to create a competitive environment for better pricing.
Always ask for all options and analyze vendor proposals critically.
Understand vendor motivations to enhance negotiation outcomes.
Leverage vendor financial information to strengthen your bargaining position.
Regularly review contracts and be proactive in renegotiation opportunities.
